findings.title: 25-candidate completeness is not reproducibly established
findings.observation: W4-METADATA-SCAN has pid/start/end/raw stdout/raw stderr all null and says no output file was created. The inventory therefore cannot demonstrate the full repository-only scan universe. Name-only inspection found authority/candidate-looking artifacts not represented in the 25 list, including AD-44 G1/G2 authority records, AD-45 fresh candidate binding envelope, and AD-55 historical G1/G2/G3 declarations/identities/receipts; AD-56-related dirty executor records also require explicit exclusion.
findings.required_action: Produce a reproducible bounded path/extension/metadata listing without opening sensitive contents, plus an exclusion register with path, reason, status, and no-promotion rationale for every omitted authority/candidate-looking artifact. Recompute the candidate count and independent hashes.
findings.claim_effect: Only the listed-25 usable=0 result is supportable; global no-input discovery remains deferred.

findings.title: absence delta lacks exact W1/W2/W3 register crosswalk
findings.observation: The 14 delta IDs merge or rename upstream IDs (for example W1 EXT-WITNESS-INDEPENDENCE, EXT-VERIFIER-POLICY, EXT-SOURCE-CLOSURE, W2 trust_root/intermediate_chain/leaf_attestor and W3 g2_authoritative_mapping). The delta has no source_ids/alias mapping, canonical upstream fingerprints, or per-register equality check, so semantic coverage cannot be mechanically shown.
findings.required_action: Add a lossless crosswalk from every W1/W2/W3 register ID to delta IDs, preserving owner/responsible party, authoritative source, recovery and expiry/revocation semantics; assert no upstream register mutation and no-repeat on unchanged fingerprints.

findings.title: validator oracle is weaker than the inventory contract
findings.observation: The validator checks hash shape, path containment, why_not presence, and two promotion flags, but does not validate path existence or recorded byte/hash values, nor type/producer/authority/signature_verification_feasibility/test_only field types. Independent checking caught that the current 25 entries do match, but the package validator alone would accept materially false metadata.
findings.required_action: Add metadata-only existence/size/hash checks and schema/type checks for every required candidate field while preserving the sensitive-content prohibition. Keep production/usable false fail-closed.
